desc:
🎃Chaos City🎃
Rebels vs. Police in the craziest city of all time!

Choose your side, pick your role, and unleash cartoon-style chaos!

🔴 REBELS: Confetti cannons, tomatoes, slime bombs, and a foam bat. Reporter, tough guy, boxer, everyone has their own style!

🔵 POLICE: Shields, paint launchers, nets, and patrol bikes. Officer, undercover agent, motorcyclist, keep the city under control!

🗳️ Vote for the game mode:
- CAPTURE ZONE: Take control of the city's districts.
- TOP K.O.: The first team to reach 40 K.O.s wins the round.

⭐ Level up, unlock gear, and collect skins  
🛵 Scooters, bikes, crazy gadgets, and tons of emotes  
🎁 Daily rewards + secret codes in the shop  
🎮 PC, mobile, tablet, and console

👥 Join the group for a welcome gift and +20% cash FOREVER!

Have fun, and may the best side win! 🏆
